countingRule: one row per BELIEF-ABOUT-INPUT. A file contributing three independent beliefs contributes three rows; a belief expressed in two files (e.g. HeaderIndex.get and PipeHeaderIndex.get) is ONE row naming both sites. Rows LDT-32..LDT-38 are the already-safe class and are not defects.

preBakeDetectableCount.rule: counted over LDT-01..LDT-31 plus LDT-33, which is the only fail-closed row carrying a source probe

adversarialReviewOfTheDeliverable.strongestRow: LDT-24, because it is the only row whose fix is a divergence test rather than a probe, and because it was MEASURED (0 divergences today) rather than asserted, which is the honest form of the finding.
weakestRows: LDT-19 and LDT-18 restate collapses the code documents openly; they earn their place only because the degradation is not declared ON THE ROW, and a reader could reasonably score them as known-and-accepted.

LDT-25 is weaker than it first looked: I initially believed the expected/actual casing was asymmetric and checked it at source before writing, and it is symmetric. The row now carries only the two residual hazards, and I state the rejected half explicitly rather than dropping it.
adversarialReviewOfTheDeliverable.whatWouldFalsifyTheWholeArtifact: If every county's StratMap DBF header is in fact identical byte-for-byte (TxGIO publishes a single schema), LDT-06, LDT-07, LDT-21 and LDT-22 collapse to near-zero exposure and the register's centre of gravity moves entirely to the vendor CAD parsers. That is one probe away from being known and is the first thing the next lane should run.
instrumentDisciplineApplied: Two candidate findings were checked and REJECTED before they could reach the artifact as claims: the BOM/HeaderIndex hypothesis (killed by executing '\uFEFFPropertyID'.trim()) and the duplicate elgin-tx registry key (killed by reading the object keys, which are elgin-tx and elgin-tx-travis). Both are recorded in COULD NOT ESTABLISH item 8 so nobody re-derives them.

The DECLARED_CAD_VINTAGES divergence was computed by a script that enumerated the UNION of both key sets rather than iterating one side, so a FIPS present in one and absent in the other would have counted as a divergence. It returned 0; a convenient result, so the union construction is stated in the row's counting rule rather than left implicit.

No repo-wide grep returning hundreds of hits was run. Every absence claim (mergeBakedBaseFacts, no orderByFields, no table_schema filter, no skip ceiling) was established by reading the file, not by an empty grep.

constraintsHonored: READ-ONLY: no commit, no checkout, no branch, no network, no database
origin/main read via `git show origin/main:<path>` only; stale local checkout never read
every command exit-bounded; no watch, tail, or server
only files written: the three _inbox artifacts named in the dispatch plus the register
